mapper.insert: insert into nad_support_ticket (conversation_id, applicant_id, opened_by_user_id, subject, category, priority, status, assigned_staff_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{applicantId}, #{openedByUserId}, #{subject}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assignedStaffId}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_support_ticket set status = #{status}, resolved_at = case when #{status} = 'RESOLVED' then now() else resolved_at end, closed_at = case when #{status} = 'CLOSED' then now() else closed_at end, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expected}
update nad_support_ticket set assigned_staff_id = #{assigneeId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
